description: Change the settings of an existing Talk conversation: description, read-only state, who can find it, lobby and message expiration. Requires moderator rights. Only the settings passed are changed.

description.description: New description, empty to clear it

listable.description: Who can find and join the conversation: 'users' for regular users, 'everyone' also includes guest accounts

lobby.description: Keep non-moderators in the lobby until it is opened

messageExpiration.description: Seconds after which messages disappear, 0 to keep them

readOnly.description: Only moderators can post or call

name: talk_update_conversation
title: Update Talk Conversation
